name: Alt: daybed first, an L of the four-screen run and a work return under the window
notes:
Alternative (F-41): the daybed gets priority. A twin VIHALS daybed takes the left wall, so the work desk turns along the window wall as the L's return and one chair in the inside corner swivels between the two desks. Gives up: a glare-free work screen (the return's monitor faces the window, so the blinds come half down), a chair per station (one serves the L), and floor BESTÅ (a door there would hit the daybed or the return).
desk-1 and desk-2 MITTZON 55 1/8 + 47 1/4: the personal run on the right wall, rot 90, x 74.5-106, y 12-114.4 (102 3/8"); F-33 6" from the heater face (heater-depth-assumed); F-31 7.6" above the door's swing (assumed-position:door); F-35 34" from their front to the daybed: 30" for the chair is met, and the 42" for someone passing behind applies only to a guest walking to the daybed's head (tight:34 then) · four 32" screens as in a.
desk-3 TRAVSPORT: the return along the window wall, rot 0, x 26.75-74, y 12-39.5, its back 6" from the heater face (F-33) · under-window, sill-unmeasured (F-38: it rises 28 3/8-46 1/8"), assumed-position:window; F-35 30" behind it at the corner chair. The laptop and the work monitor sit at its right end by the corner; its left 14", above the daybed's head, is spare surface.
chair-1 FLINTAN: the L's inside corner, x 46-74, y 41-69, facing the run or turned to the return · fits.
daybed-1 VIHALS twin daybed frame (no trundle): left wall, rot 270, x 0-40.5, y 40.4-117.5; F-33 bedding 34" from the heater face; F-31 0.5" above the wardrobe's left swing (assumed-position:closet); F-34 34" along its open side to the desks · fits. 77 1/8 x 40 1/2" closed and open: a little smaller than HEMNES and with nothing to pull out, but more than twice the chair bed of a and d.
plant-1 FEJKA monstera: the top-left corner by the window, x 4-11.5, y 25-32.5, under the wall-hung BESTÅ · fits. lamp-1 TÅGARP: bottom-left corner past the daybed's foot, x 0.5-9.5, y 119-128, left of the wardrobe's swing (assumed-position:closet), its arm over the daybed · fits.
rug-1 LOHALS (rug layer): x 22.5-74.5, y 40.5-117.5, 18" under the daybed and out to the desks. rug-2 KOLON (rug layer): x 35.1-74.5, y 41-88.25 under chair-1, its left 5" under the daybed's rail (10 1/4" free under it).
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with door (top, F-63): hung on the left wall in the top-left corner, x 0-16.5, y 12.5-36.1, its underside about 50" up on one BESTÅ suspension rail; its door swings above the return's spare end. art-1 PJÄTTERYD 3-pack (top): the three 22" canvases in a row over the daybed, y 44.9-112.9. lamp-2 RÖDFLIK (top): the return's left end, the daybed's reading lamp (under-window). lamp-3 RÖDFLIK (top): desk-2's door end.
Extras: the blinds, two HUANUO arms, two cable trays, the FREIVID mat (the return doubles as a standing station), the ELLOVEN, the suspension rail; the daybed's ÅSVANG twin mattress, DVALA fitted sheet, duvet cover, insert and pillow; three back cushions (two gray-green, one off-white) with inserts; the throw.
Not placed: the chair bed (a, d); the second FLINTAN; the floor BESTÅ; the 2026-10-22 MICKE, ALEX, BILLY and HEMNES (see a).
Prices: the new pieces as of 2026-10-23; the reused ones (FLINTAN, TÅGARP, RÖDFLIK, FEJKA, LOHALS, PJÄTTERYD, HOPPVALS, FÖRSÄSONG, ELLOVEN, bedding and textiles) as of 2026-10-22, price-stale (F-02).
